type: ({ config, children, className, style, lang, portalContainer, }: SystemProviderProps) => JSX.Element

parameters.name:
{
  config = defaultConfig,
  children,
  className,
  style,
  lang,
  portalContainer,
}

className.description: Additional classes on the existing .tiraz-system root.

lang.description: Content language; direction remains controlled by config.direction.

portalContainer.description: Optional same-document portal host; null withholds overlays until ready.

style.description: Root layout styles. Config owns --action, --radius and colorScheme.
